text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Look! That's the girl!
The one who just entered the paddock is from Victory Club...!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Follow along, Trainer!
Here we go~! Ready, set, go!

text_block_list.name: The Three
text_block_list.text: Hang in there~~!

...Swept up by Sakura Laurel and the others, I raised my voice loudly.
The reason it turned out that way on this day was—

It was because Sakura Laurel and the others invited me
to come watch a graded stakes race.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Trainer,
thank you for accompanying me today.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Though she's already a familiar face,
allow me to introduce her once more... This is Baku-chan!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Yes!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: And here's Chiyo-chan!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: I look forward to working with you today!

Sprint specialist Sakura Bakushin O,
and Derby winner Sakura Chiyono O.
Both are widely known to the public.

And the connection between them
and Sakura Laurel was—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
That's right!
Both of them are graduates of the same Umamusume training club as me, the Victory Club.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
The two of them are so kind.
Whenever they have time, they'll rush over to cheer on girls from the club... you know?♪

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Bwahahaha!
A class representative must have a heart as big as the ocean, after all!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
By the way!
Trainer, who do you think is going to win the next race!?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: The answer is: an Umamusume who runs fast!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
U-Uuuum!
When we talk about speed, it's not just pure velocity; this time we might also need a different kind of quickness!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Considering past data and the course layout,
securing a good position will be crucial.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
...I see.
Being quick on your feet mentally is important too.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Yes, speed is essential!
Speed conquers all!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: We also debuted earlier than Laurel-san! That's an important point, too!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I-In other words, that means Bakushin O-san and I
are technically Laurel-san's
"seniors on the turf"!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Including that girl from our club
who's running in this race!
choice_data_list: She's the girl you all came to cheer for, right?
You're the girl they came to cheer for, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
"...There was a period when she took a break from racing
due to 'leg troubles.'"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: I was hoping that seeing her senior's heroic figure would be of help to Laurel-san going forward.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
There are many pioneers among the alumni of Victory Club.
Even Umamusume who made a comeback after serious injuries.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
So please! Rely on us when the going gets tough!
On us—your "senpais," Laurel-san!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
"...Right. It really is amazing.
Truly wonderful girls gather here in the Victory Club."

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: I think my mother knew that too, which is why she recommended I join the club.
choice_data_list: Was your mother affiliated with the club?
Was your mother affiliated with the club?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: Apparently, it's someone who took great care of her in the past.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: My parents met in France, so even after I was born, our whole family lived over there for a while.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
"When I told her, 'I want to enter the racing world,'
she brought me to Japan the very next year.
...Leaving my father behind on a solo work assignment."

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Mom told me,
"The Victory Club will cherish
and protect your dreams."

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
"In fact, I learned so many things
from my friends and teachers at the club."

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: "No matter how weak my legs are, they taught me... how to train within those limits."

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Speaking of which, Laurel-san, you too were a prodigy
who sent shockwaves through the Club, weren't you?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Everyone's eyes went wide when you first told us your goal.
You're still aiming for it, right?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: The world's greatest stage—the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: Yeah! That's what I'm aiming for.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
If you're going to dream, aim for the very top.
Just like my father, who always strives to be the best in his field.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
"With the running style I love so much...
I will stand at the very pinnacle of the world."
choice_data_list: (To be the best in the world at what I love most...)

text_block_list.text:
Sakura Laurel's earnest posture as she spoke
of her grand dream without fear seemed so dazzling—
choice_data_list: What can I do for your dream?
I wonder what I can do for your dream?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Ho! And what is the meaning behind that!?
choice_data_list: For example... I want to know how to win!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
I see, I see!
Which means...!?
choice_data_list: I want information to win the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Does that mean they're reaching out to us, the Victory Club, for help too!?
choice_data_list: Yeah, if there were a senior who ran in the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe—
Yeah, if there were a senior who ran in the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Urk...!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: There is no such person...!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Unfortunately... there are none...!!
Not a single one from the Victory Club...!
A few days later—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Ah, Laurel-san's Trainer! What's in your hand is...
choice_data_list: Yeah, for studying the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe.
Yeah, to study for the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Ah-wawa... I'm so sorry.
Even though I acted like such a proud senior the other day...
choice_data_list: No, no! If anything, it really tightened my focus!

text_block_list.text:
Even the Victory Club, which has produced countless famous Umamusume,
has never had a senior run in the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe, which means...
That just goes to show what a high wall the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe is. Don't be naive enough to think information will just come to you if you wait around.
choice_data_list: Because I felt like I needed to push myself even harder too.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
...So that is why you have so many documents.
............

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Um, Trainer!
There aren't any upperclassmen in the Victory Club
who have gone to the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe, though.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: "Even so, there has to be some history that could help Laurel and the others! For example—"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
! The instructors at the club
have overseen so many students.
I'm sure they know ways to prevent injuries we haven't even thought of!

text_block_list.name: Club Teacher
text_block_list.text:
"...I see, so that's why
Chiyono O sent so many messages."

text_block_list.name: Club Teacher
text_block_list.text:
By the way, Trainer, how much do you know about Laurel's physical condition?
What kind of preparations have you made in mind?
choice_data_list: I'm prepared to support her no matter what.

text_block_list.name: Club Teacher
text_block_list.text:
...No matter when?
............

text_block_list.name: Club Teacher
text_block_list.text:
Understood, I shall cooperate.
I will prepare as much of our club's instructional materials as I am permitted to share.

text_block_list.name: Club Teacher
text_block_list.text:
No one must ever nip their budding potential.
Those are words we take to heart as well.
As an instructor, I will firmly... entrust them to you.

text_block_list.name: Club Teacher
text_block_list.text:
"As a Trainer who protects the future,
I need to know... that there are
all kinds of different cases, after all."

Upon returning home,
I spread out the materials from the Victory Club
alongside the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe documents on the desk.

The documents are as thick as the history that piled them up.
Carefully, I opened the first page...
What was written there was a record of a grueling battle against illness.

Too great a price, too much pain born from a single misstep.
Those who swallowed their tears and departed from the stage.

"...The history of the risks borne by those
who dare to race was deeply etched there."
—That night, I had a dream.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
"Trainer, I will...
I will definitely seize that ticket to our dream!"

Sakura Laurel was the race favorite today.
The track commentary shouted her name as well.
All eyes were on her run!

Keep up this pace and 1st place is practically guaranteed.
Sakura Laurel races across the track, cutting through the wind—

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
『Sakura Laurel ne parvientpas
 à rattraper les autres !
 Elle ralentit !』

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
『Le peloton de tête lui,
n'a pas changé...』
Sakura Laurel... suddenly decelerated.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
"Haah... haah...
Trainer...-san..."

text_block_list.name: Local Staff
text_block_list.text:
『Une civière, vite !
 Et toi, tu serais pas son
 coach par hasard ?』
With an anxious look on their face, the local staff member asks a question as if to confirm something.
choice_data_list: What do you mean?! What did you do to Laurel?!

text_block_list.name: Local Staff
text_block_list.text:
『Mais reprends tes esprits !
 Il faut que tu te
 fasses soigner, et vite !』

text_block_list.name: Local Staff
text_block_list.text:
『Direction l'hôpital !
 Si on ne fait rien,
 je crains pour le pire...』

The sweat clinging thickly to my back grows cold,
and my body begins to shiver uncontrollably.

The unrest in my chest
did not settle for quite some time.
